summary.text: Nikhil Wagle is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Scott Webster.
Wagle is an ophthalmologist and a member of the Pleasant Valley Community School District board.

paragraphs.text: Wagle earned a high school diploma from Homestead High School and an M.D. from the University of Wisconsin in 1994, along with another degree from Duke University in 1999.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and grew up in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, to parents who were first-generation immigrants from India, and that he has practiced as a physician for 27 years and is also a small business owner.
He said he has served on his local public school board for 13 years, including five as president, and on the Iowa Board of Medicine for three years.
Wagle advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
In the survey he said he is running to be a voice for patients and healthcare workers, strengthen public schools, grow the economy and address water contamination.
His stated healthcare goals include making care more affordable and accessible, addressing maternal care shortages, stopping rural hospital closures and ending the privatization of Medicaid.
